newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nomura chief says to take MOF penalties sincerely.
newsitem.headline: Nomura chief says to take MOF penalties sincerely.

text.p: Nomura Securities Co Ltd president Junichi Ujiie told reporters on Wednesday that the brokerage would accept Finance Ministry punishments sincerely.

"We take the administrative penalties with solemnity and we will make utmost efforts to ensure such events will not occur again," he told reporters as he left a meeting with the Finance Ministry's securities bureau chief Atsushi Nagano.
The Finance Ministry is scheduled to announce penalties at 5 p.m. (0800 GMT) against Nomura and Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank (DKB) Ltd for their involvement in a racketeer payoff scandal.
